title: Evenings and Weekends
subtitle: Oisín McKenna
why: A stunning and colorful cast of characters set during a heatwave in London
description: Set largely over one sweltering June weekend in 2019 across north and east London, the novel follows a sprawling, interlocking cast of friends, lovers, and family members as secrets and tensions surface. Key themes include queer identity, family, grief, commitment, and urban life. The characters are written fantastically and developed extraordinarily
